# Manatal | Product Overview

Manatal is a price-transparent, AI-enabled global ATS and recruitment of CRMs, service HRs and recruitment agencies. The core of the product is to create a unified workspace around staff, recruitment, pay/leave time or talent management, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
